column1: [controls] PC: what does holding left click do?
column2:
PC: left click shoots; hold left click for a power shot; right click passes to a teammate.
https://illegalsoccer.wiki/guides/controls/ patch 2026-11

column1: [controls] Default flick key on PC (most guides)?
column2:
PC (most-cited layout): Q flick, F lob, R request ball, Space dribble, Shift sprint, E slide tackle. Sources conflict, so check the in-game keybind menu.
https://robloxdatabase.com/guides/illegal-soccer-controls/ patch 2026-11

column1: [controls] How do you curve a shot on PC?
column2:
Curve shot: hold middle mouse while shooting and drag left/right to bend that way; controller = hold LT+RT and push right stick when the meter appears.
https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-how-to-curve-shot-controller-and-keyboard/ patch 2026-11

column1: [scoring] Why must a flick-shot kick be fully charged?
column2:
Flick shot (most-cited reliable goal): press Q to pop the ball up, jump after it, and charge the kick fully in the air toward the top of the net; partial charge drops short and is an easy catch.
https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-roblox-tips-for-flick-shots-and-goalkeeper-saves/ patch 2026-11

column1: [dribbling] Which actions cost a full stamina bar?
column2:
Stamina costs (fan-reported): dribble and slide tackle = full bar; kick/shot ~half; flick ~half; pass and lob ~quarter.
https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-dribbling-guide-stamina-costs-and-7-ball-techs/ patch 2026-11

column1: [defense] What happens after a missed slide tackle?
column2:
Only slide when the carrier is in reach: a missed slide locks you in a recovery animation and leaves nothing behind you. Press E when they are closest, don't spam.
https://illegalsoccer-roblox.wiki/guides/defense/ patch 2026-11

column1: [goalkeeping] How do you become goalkeeper?
column2:
No keeper button: standing in the rectangle in front of your own net makes you keeper (catch, punch, dive); leaving/sprinting out ends it; one keeper at a time.
https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/goalie/ patch 2026-11

column1: [items] Two S-tier items in every tier list?
column2:
Tier lists agree: Jetpack and Rocket Punch are S-tier; Freeze Gun S or A; Grappling Hook usually A; Energy Drink D in every list.
https://progameguides.com/roblox/roblox-illegal-soccer-items-tier-list/ patch 2026-11

column1: [modes] Ranked entry requirement?
column2:
Ranked has two queues with separate Elo: Illegal (items on) and Legal (items off). Needs 5 owned items to enter; 10 placement matches.
https://savepointmag.com/2026/10/07/illegal-soccer-roblox-en/ patch 2026-11

column1: [modes] Explain the Last Chance rule.
column2:
Last Chance rule: if the trailing team is down by one when time ends, play continues until they lose possession; if they score, it goes to overtime.
https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-11

column1: [ranked-system] What are the two ranked queues in Illegal Soccer and what differs between them?
column2:
Ranked has two separate queues, each with its own Elo and leaderboard: Illegal Ranked (items allowed) and Legal Ranked (no items).
Sportskeeda https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/illegal-soccer-ranked-mode-guide

column1: [ranked-system] What do you need before ranked unlocks, and how many placement matches are there?
column2:
To queue ranked you need 5 owned items (3 are given by default, the other 2 come from rolls at 1,000 Coins each), then 10 placement matches decide your starting rank.
Sportskeeda https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/illegal-soccer-ranked-mode-guide

column1: [ranked-system] List the Illegal Soccer rank tiers in order. How many players can be Hall of Fame?
column2:
Rank ladder (per Sportskeeda): Bronze, Silver, Gold, All-Star, Legend, World Class, each with divisions I-III, then Hall of Fame, which holds only the top 150 players. Other fan wikis list Bronze-Silver-Gold-Platinum-Diamond-Champion; that list contradicts video titles (All-Star 1, World Class, Hall of Fame) and looks wrong.
Sportskeeda https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/illegal-soccer-ranked-mode-guide

column1: [experts] How do you curve a shot on PC in Illegal Soccer?
column2:
Curve shot on PC: hold Middle Mouse while shooting and drag the mouse left or right to set spin (controller: LT+RT plus the right stick). Flick variant: tap Q to pop the ball chest-high, then volley curved right away. Raise curve sensitivity in settings.
allthings.how https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-how-to-curve-shot-controller-and-keyboard/

column1: [tactics] Last seconds, you lead 3-2 and they have the ball: what ends the match?
column2:
Last Chance only triggers when the trailing team is down by exactly one goal at time-out AND holds the ball; leading team: win possession back at the buzzer (tackle/intercept/keeper catch) and the match ends; a community wiki adds that if the leading team touches the ball first, it ends immediately.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-08-28+

column1: [tactics] Down 1 with 10s left, why not just shoot from distance?
column2:
Trailing by one in the last ~30s: secure possession before the clock hits zero; Last Chance keeps the match alive only while you still hold the ball, so a hopeful long shot right before the buzzer that gets caught throws away the extra attack.
allthings.how https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-on-roblox-how-to-play-controls-and-item-boxes/ patch 2026-11

column1: [tactics] Teammate drops a barricade on the near post. Where does the keeper stand?
column2:
A barricade on the near post invites a far-post shot: if you wall one side, the keeper must shade to the open (far) side, not stay centred.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/guide/roblox-tips/ patch 2026-11

column1: [tactics] Why should non-keepers avoid the rectangle in a goalmouth scramble?
column2:
Keeper is positional: a forward chasing a loose ball into your own box can accidentally become keeper (only one at a time), blocking the real keeper's abilities; teammates must stay out of the rectangle during scrambles.
illegalsoccer.wiki https://illegalsoccer.wiki/guides/ranked-matches/ patch 2026-11

column1: [tactics] How many item bans per team in Illegal Ranked and how is it decided?
column2:
Item ban (Illegal Ranked, one ban per team by vote): ban the specific item the enemy leans on (e.g. a player spamming Jetpack), not blindly the tier-list top; Jetpack, Rocket Punch and Freeze Gun are the consensus strongest.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/progression/leaderboards/ patch 2026-09

column1: [tactics] What did the Nov 2026 New Map & New Item update change for keepers?
column2:
Nov 2026 update: new map 'Stadium' (boosted spawn rate for a week), Go-Kart item (boosted kart knocks players over; full-power kicks or item hits destroy it), keepers take slightly less knockback, and private servers get a 'Map' setting for scrims on a chosen map.
Repotted (Roblox event page) https://www.roblox.com/events/8505384876533482130 patch 2026-11

column1: [tactics] How do you destroy a Go-Kart?
column2:
Counter the Go-Kart: a full-power kick or any item hit blows it up, so the defender shoots the ball/item into the kart rather than trying to tackle the driver.
Repotted (Roblox event page) https://www.roblox.com/events/8505384876533482130 patch 2026-11

column1: [dribbling-advanced] What does pressing dribble do to a kick/pass/lob/flick you are charging?
column2:
Official balancing change: pressing dribble cancels an in-progress kick/pass/lob/flick charge, and a charge can also end a dribble early. Use it as an animation cancel: start a charge to bait a tackle, then dribble out of it.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-09-08

column1: [dribbling-advanced] Can you slide after locking onto a volley (current patch)?
column2:
Official change: you can no longer slide after locking onto a volley, so slide-volley clips from before the update are not current tech. The flick-jump-slide still works only if you slide before a volley lock.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-09-08

column1: [dribbling-advanced] How do you beat an incoming slide tackle with a flick?
column2:
Flick-catch vs a slide tackle: while moving forward, flick (Q) the ball up and rise with it, reclaiming it before it lands, so the incoming slide passes under you. You did it right if the tackler slides beneath you and you keep the ball.
allthings.how https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-dribbling-guide-stamina-costs-and-7-ball-techs/ patch 2026-11

column1: [dribbling-advanced] When should you press dribble against a defender?
column2:
Dribble (Space) is a dodge: press it just as the defender commits to a tackle, never while you have open space. Use it to beat ONE committed defender, not to run through several. Spamming space is the most-cited beginner mistake.
allthings.how https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-controls-and-best-items-guide-roblox/ patch 2026-11

column1: [patch-history] When was the Illegal Soccer Roblox place created vs publicly launched?
column2:
Release: Roblox place created May 12, 2026 (GameFAQs, Rolimons); Repotted announced the public launch Aug 27, 2026 and coverage says it took off in September. Treat May 12 as page creation, late Aug/Sep as public launch.
GameFAQs https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/roblox/724685-illegal-soccer/data patch launch-2026-05

column1: [patch-history] How long does Supercharge last after its nerf?
column2:
Official update log balance entry (date not visible in snippet): Supercharge shortened from 10s to 7s; Magnet pull weaker at range; Forcefield breaks after one hit but lasts 10s.
Repotted https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-08/09

column1: [patch-history] What is required to queue Ranked, and how many placement matches?
column2:
Ranked update (Rival Ducks title [RANKED!] 2026-09-19; wiki cites Sep 20 log): Illegal Ranked (items) and Legal Ranked (no items), separate Elo/leaderboards, 5 owned items required, 10 placement matches, an item ban in Illegal (wiki: vote; Sportskeeda: each team bans one item), ladder Bronze to Hall of Fame (top 150).
illegalsoccerroblox.wiki https://illegalsoccerroblox.wiki/guides/ranked-and-clubs/ patch 2026-09-19

column1: [patch-history] What does the Sledgehammer do and what rarity is it?
column2:
'New items & player cards' update (Roblox event, date not shown): Grenade (Rare, 2 throws per pickup, bounces then explodes), Sledgehammer (Epic, leap + ground slam ragdolls close players and shoves others), 21 player cards incl. two Illegal cards with 50 numbered copies, duplicates turn into Dust to buy a chosen card, goalkeepers take less knockback, ranked rejoin fix, private-server setting, 10-roll change.
Repotted https://www.roblox.com/events/5653953232750379634 patch 2026-10

column1: [patch-history] What destroys an enemy Go-Kart?
column2:
Nov 1, 2026 'New Map & New Item' (event Nov 1-7): Stadium map (more likely to appear for a week), Go-Kart item: drops a kart under you, drifting turns faster and charges a turbo; boosted kart knocks players over; full-power kicks and item hits blow the kart up; private-server Map setting; goalkeeper knockback balance change.
Repotted https://www.roblox.com/events/8505384876533482130 patch 2026-11-01

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] Can a diving keeper be pushed (post Sep 2026 balance)?
column2:
Official update log (Balancing): goalkeepers can no longer be pushed while diving. A committed dive can't be shoved off its line, so attackers must beat the dive itself rather than bump the keeper.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-09

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] What did the Sep 2026 balance pass change about keepers vs redirected kicks?
column2:
Official update log: goalkeepers got slightly longer to react to kicks that change direction mid-charge. Late drag/redirect fakes are weaker than in older videos, so pre-Sep shot-fake tutorials overstate them.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-09

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] How long is post-catch/possession immunity reportedly, and what ends it early?
column2:
6-second window: several fan sources (allthings.how, Grokipedia, illegalsoccergame.wiki) say a keeper catch starts about 6 s of immunity, used to reposition and throw. Another wiki says the 6 s applies to any player gaining possession and that holding past 6 s ends the immunity. No developer source found, so it is community-reported, not confirmed. Test it in a private server.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/progression/levels/ patch 2026-11

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] Where do you confirm keeper binds when guides disagree?
column2:
Keeper keybinds differ between sources. September settings reportedly put Dive on Q and E (shared with Flick), while an older guide used F=dive/lofted clearance, Q=throw, G=punch. The HUD legend switches to Punch and Dive when the game announces you as keeper, so trust the on-screen prompts and check them at the start of each patch.
illegalsoccer-roblox.wiki https://illegalsoccer-roblox.wiki/guides/controls/ patch 2026-09

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] What's the default distribution after a keeper catch?
column2:
Distribution: after a catch, use the outlet pass (right mouse button, the general pass/request key) to a teammate instead of dribbling out of the zone. Dribbling out drops keeper status and exposes the ball.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/goalie/ patch 2026-11

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] What is the keeper punch used for?
column2:
Punch is for the man, not the ball: punch an attacker who closes on the goal mouth before they can shoot. It is a melee knock-away on a nearby player.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/goalie/ patch 2026-11

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] Which three curve combos are hardest for keepers?
column2:
Hardest curves for keepers: Flick-Up Curve (Q then MMB+drag), Wall-Kick Curve (two direction changes, so the keeper pivots twice) and Fire-Ball Curve (fire boost leaves almost no reaction time). Against Fire-Ball curves, pre-position rather than react.
Aprasi blog https://www.aprasi.com/blogs/trending-topics/curve-shots-illegal-soccer-roblox-guide patch 2026-11

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] Does shot-cancel fake work on AI keepers?
column2:
Anti-keeper shot cancel: start a shot then cancel to create a 'fake white line' that can make a human keeper dive the wrong way, then shoot the vacated side. Cancelling too early shows no fake animation. Another wiki says AI keepers are not faked by cancels, so this only works on humans. It was likely weakened by the Sep 2026 redirect-reaction buff.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/how-to-cancel-a-shot/ patch 2026-11

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] What's the AI keeper's exploitable habit?
column2:
AI keeper: commits to one side by habit (exploit by shooting the other side every time). The top corner away from it is the hardest angle for the keeper system. The same wiki claims a 7-stud hitbox and a 0.2 s reaction window, which are unverified.
illegal-soccer-wiki.wiki https://illegal-soccer-wiki.wiki/en/guides/illegal-soccer-roblox-guide/ patch 2026-11

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] Best item to remove a keeper right before shooting?
column2:
Anti-keeper item: Rocket Punch locks onto the keeper right before your shot and sends them across the pitch, leaving the net empty. Its hit strength now matches a fully charged kick per the Sep 8 log.
allthings.how https://allthings.how/roblox-illegal-soccer-guide-best-items-and-how-to-score/ patch 2026-09

column1: [goalkeeping-advanced] What must happen when your keeper leaves the box?
column2:
Keeper switching: the role is positional and one at a time. If someone already holds the box you are an outfield defender. Leaving the box returns normal outfield movement. When the keeper pushes up, a teammate must immediately fill the goal area.
illegal-soccer.wiki https://www.illegal-soccer.wiki/guide/Illegal-Soccer-roblox patch 2026-11

column1: [foreign-scene] What happens if you hit yourself with your own rocket launcher?
column2:
[PT-BR, SavePoint] Hitting yourself with your own rocket launcher still launches you upward, so it doubles as a self-boost for aerial plays; there are achievements for 3+ s airborne on the jetpack and for scoring from a strike taken high in the air.
SavePoint https://savepoint.com.br/2026/10/07/illegal-soccer-roblox/ patch Oct 2026

column1: [foreign-scene] What is the top rank tier in Illegal Soccer ranked?
column2:
[ES, official Roblox event page 'Logros - Fútbol Prohibido'] 50+ achievements track career goals, assists, saves and tackles and every rank tier up to Hall of Fame; in ranked, AFK players are pulled out of the match and return as soon as they move.
Repotted (official) https://www.roblox.com/events/5366948543695291147

column1: [scoring] How do you cancel a charged shot to fake the keeper?
column2:
Shot cancel (fake shot): start charging the power shot (hold LMB), wait for the keeper's first reaction, press dribble (Space) just before the ball leaves the foot, then shoot to the opposite side once they dive. Cancel too late = ball goes at the keeper; too early = no fake animation to bite on. (Fan wiki.)
https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/how-to-cancel-a-shot/

column1: [goalkeeping] What happens if two teammates are in the keeper zone at once?
column2:
If several teammates stand in your keeper rectangle, all of them get keeper controls and lose the ability to shoot, so don't crowd your own box when defending. (Fan wiki.)
https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/goalie/

column1: [shooting-advanced] Shot cancel: what happens if you press Space too late vs too early?
column2:
Shot cancel (fake shot): charge a power shot (hold LMB), then press the dribble key (Space) just before the ball leaves your foot. Too late = ball fires straight at the keeper; too early = no fake animation, so no bait. Drill the window in Free Play.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/how-to-cancel-a-shot/ patch 2026-11

column1: [shooting-advanced] Does a cancelled-shot fake work on AI keepers?
column2:
Fake-curve sequence: start a curve-shot animation to drag the keeper to one side, cancel with Space, re-aim to the open side and fire the real shot. Fan guide says it only fools human keepers; AI keepers are not baited by cancels.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/how-to-cancel-a-shot/ patch 2026-11

column1: [shooting-advanced] Per SavePoint, when in the shot do you hold the curve input?
column2:
Curve input DISAGREEMENT: SavePoint says curving (added 14 Sep 2026) works by starting a kick charge, then while still charging holding RIGHT click and moving the mouse (trackpad: T); most fan guides say hold MIDDLE mouse and drag. Curve is a rebindable row in Settings, so check your keybind menu, especially after the Nov 'new curve' change.
SavePoint https://savepointmag.com/2026/10/07/illegal-soccer-roblox-en/ patch 2026-11

column1: [shooting-advanced] What happens to camera sensitivity while charging a kick?
column2:
Official update log lists reduced camera sensitivity while charging a kick: set your aim/camera before you start charging, because turning mid-charge is slowed.
Repotted (official site) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-11

column1: [shooting-advanced] Bicycle kick: which direction do you jump relative to the ball?
column2:
Self-fed bicycle kick: near the opponent's goal, kick the ball into a wall so it rebounds to you, jump BACKWARD (away from the ball) as it arrives, and fire the shot command mid-air; layer the curve input on top for a bicycle-curve.
illegalsoccergame.wiki https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/how-to-do-a-bicycle-kick/ patch 2026-11

column1: [shooting-advanced] Which volley beats a keeper off his line, and what key?
column2:
Three airborne volley types: kick volley = LMB (power/range), pass volley = RMB (close-range redirect/one-touch), lob volley = F (chip a keeper who has left the line). Choose by keeper position, not habit.
illegalsoccer-wiki.wiki https://illegalsoccer-wiki.wiki/techniques/illegal-soccer-volley/ patch 2026-11

column1: [items-advanced] How long does Supercharge last after the August nerf?
column2:
Official balance: Supercharge lasts 7s (cut from 10s). Pop it only once you already have the ball heading into the final third, not on a loose ball, or the window runs out before the shot.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-08-26+

column1: [items-advanced] Forcefield: duration, and how many hits does it absorb?
column2:
Official balance: Forcefield lasts 10s but breaks after ONE hit. Counter: pop it with any cheap hit (Flintlock, Grenade splash, a bump) and then tackle, or just wait out the 10s. (The counter is inferred from the rule.)
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-08-26+

column1: [items-advanced] What happens to Magnet pull strength with distance?
column2:
Official balance: Magnet pull gets weaker with distance, and a later entry makes the falloff start earlier. Use it close to the loose ball. To counter, stay far from a Magnet holder's position, or win the ball first in close scrambles.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-08+

column1: [items-advanced] Was Freeze Gun's hitbox buffed or nerfed?
column2:
Official balance: Freeze Gun's blast hitbox was made slightly bigger (a buff), so near-misses that used to whiff can now land.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-08+

column1: [items-advanced] Rocket Punch hit strength equals what?
column2:
Official balance: Rocket Punch hit strength now equals a fully-charged kick. Treat a Rocket Punch on the ball as a free max-power strike with no charge time.
Repotted (official update log) https://illegalsoccer.com/ patch 2026-08+

column1: [items-advanced] How many Grenade throws per pickup?
column2:
Grenade (Rare): 2 throws per pickup, bounces before exploding (a few seconds' fuse). Because of the bounce and fuse, aim it where the play will be, not where it is now.
Repotted (official Roblox event page) https://www.roblox.com/events/5653953232750379634 patch 2026-11

column1: [items-advanced] What do duplicate item rolls give you now?
column2:
Mastery: rolling a duplicate of an owned item earns mastery for that item, unlocking up to 5 extra skins per item (added in the Oct 17 update). Duplicates are not wasted rolls.
timesaver.gg https://timesaver.gg/blog/illegal-soccer-codes patch 2026-10-17+

column1: [items-advanced] How many item bans per team in Illegal Ranked?
column2:
Illegal Ranked reportedly has one item ban per team. Ban the item you can't counter (often Jetpack, Rocket Punch or Freeze Gun) and build your loadout around what's left.
fan wiki (attribution approximate) https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/progression/ranked/ patch 2026-09+
